name: Himukai Asahi
source:
"[i]Starting today, the four of us will be living here together. I'm looking forward to the day when, while living this kind of life, you find your own answer.[/i]"

A [b]special cat[/b] who can transform into a human.

She’s Tooya’s older sister.
She is calm, composed by nature, speaks in a boyish manner and is also a good cook.

She enjoys experiencing human culture such as novels, movies, and paintings,
and finds works aimed at the otaku public particularly fascinating.

She calls herself a "[b]sorceress of the night[/b]."
She entrusted a certain "[b]role[/b]" to Taiga, the protagonist.

[b]Profile[/b]
[i]Height[/i]: 162cm
[i]Measurements[/i]: B90 / W58 / H89
[i]Favorite food[/i]: Flour-based foods (like okonomiyaki, etc.). Also ramune.
[i]Blood type[/i]: A
[i]Birthday[/i]: November 11th

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]
